decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical boot-record structure definitions.
evidence: The file matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS loader, disk, IOCTL and initialization sources include bootform.inc.

Previously compared selected IO.SYS contributions of MSDISK (1945 bytes), MSDIOCTL (1733 bytes), and MSBIO2 (807 code bytes and 335 initialized data bytes) match the target; see reviews 009, 011 and 012.
The prior MSLOAD comparison differs only in the shared version byte among 1446 bytes; see review 019.
limitations: These module comparisons support definitions used in the selected build, not every structure field or other configuration. Final IO.SYS linking and whole-file equality remain pending.
